description: Send one signed webhook.test event to a webhook's URL now, through the normal delivery path, and report whether it arrived (delivered, http_status, error_reason, duration_ms). Use it to check an endpoint and its signature verification. It is logged in the webhook's deliveries, goes even to a paused endpoint, is not retried, and leaves the endpoint's health unchanged. livemode follows the key. Up to 10 a minute per account.

webhook_id.description: Webhook ID to send the test event to.

name: send_webhook_test
title: Send webhook test event
